title: Two-variable Parity Polynomial for Virtual Knotoids
summary: In this paper, we introduce a two-variable parity polynomial invariant for virtual knotoids, defined on oriented virtual knotoid diagrams. The construction is based on the parity of classical crossings, where each crossing is classified as even or odd and treated accordingly in the definition of the invariant. We study several fundamental properties of this invariant.
